description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveBalanceAPI class, which provides API endpoints for retrieving leave balance information within an Employee HR management system. It includes methods to get leave balances for specific leave types and employees, with support for date ranges and leave breakdowns. The class leverages traits for auxiliary services and handles detailed data normalization and result formatting.

classes.name: LeaveBalanceAPI
classes.description: Provides REST API endpoints to fetch employee leave balance details, including specific leave types and date ranges, with breakdowns and normalization.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve leave balance for a specific leave type and employee, optionally within a date range, returning normalized data with employee and leave type metadata.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeAsArray
methods.description: Fetches leave type details by ID and normalizes them into an array form.

methods.name: getNormalizedLeaveBalanceResult
methods.description: Normalizes leave balance breakdown over periods, marking negative balances and detailed leave data.

methods.name: getLeaveBreakdownForAppliedDateRange
methods.description: Generates leave day breakdowns over a date range, segmented by leave periods and holiday weekends.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the leave period object based on a date, employee number, and leave type, using the entitlement strategy.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the getOne API request, including optional date range parameters.
